summary: Myseum.AI filed an 8-K reporting a Second Amendment to its February 10, 2025 Sales Agreement, under which The Benchmark Company assigned its sales-agent role to affiliate StoneX Financial Inc. The company also filed Amendment No. 2 to its February 6, 2026 prospectus supplement to reflect the agent change. No share price, offering size, or terms were disclosed, and no board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a routine at-the-market agent substitution and prospectus update, not a special situation; watch only for any future takedowns under the amended agreement.
